title: Introduction to Piecewise-Linear Topology
author: C.P.Rourke and B.J.Sanderson
locator: 1972 edition, Chapter4 opening definitions, printed p.50 / PDF p.58; stars and links immediately thereafter
text: A pair of polyhedra consists of a polyhedron and a subpolyhedron. When both are PL balls it is a ball pair. Ball-pair status is preserved by PL homeomorphisms of pairs; a literal cone pair is the local star construction and is not required of every geometrically embedded ball pair. Properness and unknottedness are separately defined qualifications.
scope: Compare the general ball-pair definition and its invariance, not a claim that every proper ball pair is unknotted. Lean indices use ambient dimension m+1 and subball dimension k; after cone-model representability may still be narrower than all ball pairs and requires separate review.
